results.text: Comparative Efficacy of Venlafaxine and Other Medications in Migraine: A Meta-Analysis with Trial Sequential Analysis. This meta-analysis with trial sequential analysis (TSA) evaluated the efficacy of venlafaxine in migraine prevention through database searches from inception to 1st November 2024. A total of eight studies involving 582 patients were included.
